paused_banner: Paused — resume to continue live updates (useful to catch brief Recv/Resp gaps).
hint_running: Newest bucket on the left. Running dense 0.25×/0.5×(default)/1×/2×; window = default × dense. Recv/Resp fill after STATUS; pause to freeze a gap.
hint_raw: X = time (fits width). Y = bucket group (fits height). Z = latency. View only sets direction — Front/Top/Free share Free-3D controls. Spectrum is a sliding-window spectrogram (X still time). Raw dense 0.5×/1×(default)/2×; window = default × dense².
note_overview: Offered {offered} requests, sent {sent}, received {received}, lost {lost}. Achieved {achieved_rps} req/s vs target {lambda_rps} req/s.
note_warming_up: Still warming up ({sent} sent); stats stabilize in a few seconds.
note_rate_ok: Send rate matches the target ({achieved_rps} / {lambda_rps} req/s, {ratio_pct}%).
note_rate_shortfall: Achieved {achieved_rps} req/s, below target {lambda_rps} ({ratio_pct}%). Local TX queue or the path is limiting.
note_jitter_low: Low jitter. RFC 3550 jitter {jitter_us}, mean RTT {mean_rtt_us}, P99 {p99_us}.
note_jitter_high: High jitter. RFC 3550 jitter {jitter_us}, mean RTT {mean_rtt_us} (CV {cv}), P50 {p50_us}, P99 {p99_us}. Latency is bouncing, not just steady queuing.
note_client_tx_backlog: Local TX still has {client_tx} requests queued (threshold {threshold}). Sending is slower than Poisson arrivals.
note_server_rx_backlog: Server still has {server_rx} requests unread/unanalyzed (threshold {threshold}). Server processing lags arrivals.
note_server_tx_backlog: Server still has {server_tx} responses not leaving the NIC (threshold {threshold}). TX side or peer window is backing up.
note_keeping_up: Queues are shallow and loss is negligible. The path is keeping up.
note_poisson_ok: Inter-arrival CV {cv}, close to exponential 1 (mean {mean_us}, expected {expected_us}). Load still looks Poisson.
note_poisson_off: Inter-arrival CV {cv}, off exponential (ideal CV ≈ 1, mean {mean_us}, expected {expected_us}). Scheduling smoothed or burst the flow.
note_timeline_lag: Response timeline lags requests by about {slices} slices ({ms} ms). Includes path delay and possible clock skew.
note_server_hold: Server hold from read to response: P50 {p50_us}, P95 {p95_us}. Includes wait in the receive queue.
note_local_queue_dominates: Local queue delay P50 {queue_delay_p50_us} already exceeds mean in-flight RTT {mean_rtt_us}. Slowdown is mostly before leaving the NIC.
note_clock_skew: Slice clocks differ by {slices} ({ms} ms). Timeline alignment mixes in clock skew.
note_no_server_status: No STATUS yet. Server queues and timelines are empty for now.
note_echo_mismatch: {mismatch} ECHO replies did not match request bytes.
